assumption_ledger.note: No explicit timeline for shim removal provided in release notes; assumed to be addressed after schema audit completes.
No explicit confirmation that canary environment is configured for dashboard summary testing.

dependency_notes.reason: Dashboard summary consumes the step-id schema produced by the translator; schema drift must be resolved first.
Dashboard summary must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect the new schema to catch ordering regressions.
Runbook only stabilizes after the rollout and rollback shape are known from canary testing.

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift audit report with identified gaps and a plan to remove the legacy parser shim.
ordered_steps.summary: Audit and resolve schema drift in the translator before removing the legacy parser shim. This de-risks subsequent work from masking issues.
ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated test fixtures in tests/plan_contract.py that validate dependency ordering.
ordered_steps.summary: Add dependency-graph fixtures so the plan contract catches ordering regressions when new step ids are introduced.
ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary feature gated behind a kill switch, ready for canary rollout.
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the translated release-plan dashboard summary behind a kill switch after schema is stable and fixtures are in place.
ordered_steps.title: Enable dashboard summary behind kill switch

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated runbook documenting rollout and rollback procedures.
ordered_steps.summary: Update the operator runbook and launch checklist after the summary path is proven in canary.
ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist

mitigations: Audit schema drift (RN-101) before any dashboard work
Backfill dependency-graph fixtures (RN-102) to catch ordering regressions in tests
Keep dashboard summary behind a kill switch during canary validation
primary_risk.statement: The release dashboard will render incorrect or unstable ordering if the translator schema drift is not resolved before enabling the dashboard summary.
